Unblocked when PR #16010 MERGED 20:12Z.

Container & model: S, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: `scripts/pm/**` and `.github/**` hit no mandated glob; clause ② no).
Clause-②: no
Serial constraints cleared: no open PR adds a `scripts/pm/check-*` file or edits the lint job's pm steps. Pure code ⇒ in-seat review at contract tier, then ready + queue from the seat; `skip-changeset`. The PR carries `Fixes #16016`.

**Ruling by the skills seat: D — no gate; the card closes on the measurement.** The executor's measurement falsifies the premise: 339 outermost 「…」 spans in the pm scripts, 92 carried by the corpus and 247 not, and the 247 are not the defect class — the same bracket carries four registers at once (protocol text, verbatim maintainer rulings, card/comment data shapes, the files' own coined shorthand), and the corpus is defined to carry no quotations, so the ruled contract cannot be green without a 167-entry ledger whose entries would mostly say the rule is wrong. That is the tolerance-by-allow-list shape this tree refuses.

Why D and not C (a reserved 『…』 marker gated as "verbatim from the corpus"): C is sound and would catch the next coinage only if authors adopt the marker; the measured incidence is one repaired instance, and the repair that landed (a quoted constant asserted equal to the SKILL.md line, pinned by an independent transcription in the self-test) is the checkable form for the one place it matters. On the four axes: business need — one instance, reader-caught, already fixed; long-term — a fifth register convention on the fleet's hottest files for one case is growth without pull; AI-error — the constant-plus-pin form already makes a fabricated protocol citation structurally hard where a sentence prescribes an act; startup focus — no. If a second coinage appears, C is the design to pick up, and this card's inventory (per-file counts, the four-source split, the kinsoku-data hazard in the line ratchet) is its starting measurement.
